description: This file defines classes and methods related to PDF stream filtering, including filter names, filter retrieval, encoding, and decoding functionalities for various PDF compression and encryption filters.

classes.name: PdfFilterNames
classes.description: Contains constants for PDF filter names and their abbreviations.

classes.name: Filtering
classes.description: Provides static methods to get, encode, and decode PDF stream filters based on filter names.

methods.name: GetFilter
methods.description: Returns a filter object based on the filter name string.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes data using the specified filter.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes data using the specified filter and parameters.

methods.name: DecodeToString
methods.description: Decodes data to a string using the specified filter.
